q: A distinguishing feature of performance budgeting is that expenditure is classified by:

options.A: Functions, programmes, activities and projects, instead of only by objects of expenditure
options.B: The source from which the funds are received
options.C: The grade of the officer incurring the expenditure
options.D: The month in which the expenditure is incurred

q: For performance budgeting to work effectively, an essential supporting requirement is:

options.A: Abolition of the object-wise classification of expenditure

options.D: Exemption of the programmes from any financial review
